statements.text: We shouldn’t be giving tax breaks to massive corporations building data centers in our communities that can drive up energy costs and drain our water supply.

statements.text: To me, the heart of the data center debate is who decides, and that ought to be the local community [...] If a town decides a project is worth it to land the jobs or increase their tax base, that’s their decision. But if they don’t want one, that should be their decision, too

statements.text: It’s kind of a Tower of Babel.
